intro: A template says how cards are made from the entries of one kind — e.g. “Who wrote {title}?” with the authors field as the answer. Start from a ready-made start or from an empty graph.
directionHint: Changing the direction or the questions starts the card history over only where the correct answer changed.
tests: What this card tests — for knowledge
testsHint: Knowledge belongs to the entry, and the card is evidence: each answer counts for the entries listed here, with this weight (a precise question — more, a general one — less). Without a setting: this entry with weight 1.
asks: Which fact it asks about — shared answers
asksHint: Cards that ask about the same fact of the same entry share every answer: a good answer to “When was X?” also counts for “What happened in 1829?”, if both templates name the fact the same way (e.g. “data”). Without a setting the card counts only for itself.
noEntry: There is no entry of this kind yet.
noCard: No card is made from this entry (e.g. an empty field or an unmet condition).
askDelete: Delete the template? Its cards will disappear from reviews (answers stay).
